description: This Java class defines an actor for consuming messages from an AMQP message broker, specifically using the JMS API and Akka actor model. It manages JMS message consumers, handles message receipt, processes headers and payloads, acknowledges messages, and manages consumer lifecycle events. The class integrates with an external message processing pipeline and supports rate limiting and consumer recreation.

classes.name: AmqpConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for consuming messages from an AMQP source via JMS, processing headers and payloads, managing the lifecycle of JMS message consumers, implementing rate limiting, and forwarding messages to processing actors.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumer
classes.description: A helper class representing a request to create a new JMS message consumer with associated consumer data.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumerResponse
classes.description: A response class containing the created JMS MessageConsumer and associated consumer data.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Akka Props for this actor, initializing it with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, specifying how different message types are processed.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the message consumer when the actor is starting.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the actor is stopping, including closing the JMS message consumer.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming JMS messages and forwards them to the actor's self mailbox for processing.

methods.name: handleJmsMessage
methods.description: Processes a received JMS message: extracts headers and payload, creates external messages, forwards to processing actors, and handles acknowledgements.
